method: Same cached Gangnam roads. Profiling run and preliminary 3 km sequence excluded from 5 km comparison. Timed runs sample CPU/thermal state through adb, without Hermes sampling. Telemetry itself can add overhead; frequencies are snapshots, not average clocks.

correctness.phoneChecks: All 5 km runs: identical five unrounded candidate scores and routing diagnostics; full route coordinates not exported by phone metrics.

profile.method: Counts of samples with an engine ancestor; approximate proportions, not exact function durations. Profiled runs are excluded from wall-time comparisons.

indexedLoops.conclusion: Slower in all three observed pairs: not adopted.

preliminary3KmNote: The first three measurements retained the default 3 km. They are a separate same-process observation, never compared against 5 km timings. The harness subsequently asserted targetKm, routing and scores.
